title: Adjacency under vertex relabeling
statement: Let $v$ be a natural number, let $G$ assign a Boolean value to each two-element subset of the $v$ vertices, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the vertices, and let $u,w$ be vertices. The vertices $\sigma(u)$ and $\sigma(w)$ are adjacent in the relabeled graph if and only if $u$ and $w$ are adjacent in $G$.
hypotheses_covered: vertices u and w in Fin v
